Subject: QBR Capacity Prioritization: infra action register & sprint asks

Team —

As QBR prep this week, I put together a short action register (attached) to get us aligned on the infra asks we should surface to Leadership on Monday. Key context: runway sensitivity is highest if we don’t bend GPU spend by Jan—batching & KV caching experiments have the biggest near-term payoff but require prioritization from infra/serving.

Top asks (please treat as itemized decisions we need by end of day Monday):
- Rank the 6 candidate capacity asks by expected unit-econ delta (token cost / 1000) and call out estimated impact to monthly GPU spend. (owner: Karthik)
- Confirm Dec–Mar GPU forecast (baseline vs. optimistic) so we can lock Dedicated reserve discussion with CloudOps. I put a preliminary forecast tab in the sheet. (owner: Vivek)
- Approve experiment slate: (1) continuous batching change to 10ms max-latency window (2) prefix KV cache retention increase (3) quantized model pilot for L1 route — estimate ROI in the sheet. Each needs an owner + risk note. (owners: Irene + Serving)
- Identify any blocking procurement/legal items if we want to bump Dedicated capacity in Jan. (owner: Lauren)

Attached: qbr-infra-prioritization.xlsx (overview + quick ROI calc), capacity-estimates-dec-mar.csv (forecast scenarios).

Please reply with the ranked list inline or update the sheet (link below). If we can get a decision matrix by EOD Mon, I’ll synthesize slides for Leadership.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQBRSheet

Thanks —
Soojin

Subject: Re: QBR Capacity Prioritization: infra action register & sprint asks

Quick prioritization and numbers (see attached csv for the scenario table):

Rank (1 highest impact by estimated monthly GPU $ saved):
1) KV prefix retention increase (medium effort) — estimated monthly GPU delta: ~$210k (primarily reduces token re-computation for multi-turn chat)
2) Continuous batching latency cap + adaptive batch sizing (higher effort due to runtime changes) — estimated monthly GPU delta: ~$160k but with risk to tail p99 unless canaryed
3) Model quantization pilot (L1 routes) — one-time engineering uplift, ongoing ~$90k/month savings depending on quality delta; requires eval set to validate
4) Route routing policy changes (shift L2->L3 where acceptable) — ~$50k/month
5) Move cold-serving to spot pools + pre-warm window — ~$30k/month (procurement complexity)
6) Misc: token-level caching improvements & small infra tuning — ~$12k/month

Baseline forecast (Dec–Mar):
- Baseline spend (no interventions): $1.85M/month
- With prioritized slate (1–3 implemented phased): $1.35M/month by Mar (rough)

Notes:
- Assumes utilization improves from 58% -> 72% for L1/L2 after batching + caching combined.
- Batch window: moving to 10ms increases average batch size by ~1.7x on current traffic; but p99 tail must be closely monitored.
- Quantization assumptions: 8-bit FP with small calibration loss; costs assume immediate 2.6x throughput improvement on T4-like hardware.

Attached: gpu-spend-scenarios.csv (detailed breakdown). I updated the spreadsheet with these numbers in the "estimates" tab.

Karthik
Director, Cost & Capacity Modeling

Attached is our SOW draft (cloudops-sow-draft.pdf) with two capacity options: Standard (30% cheaper with 10-day leadtime) and Priority (higher allocation guarantee, 2-week SLA, 18% premium).

If you can confirm by Wed EOD, we’ll lock pricing for the Priority option and start the procurement flow.
